# Card

```tsx
import { Card, CardMoreActions, cardVariants, cardFooterVariants } from "@s0l/design-system"
```

A surface that groups a title, description and actions about one subject. Mirrors the Figma Card: State (Default / Pressed / Disabled) + Focus, with the .Card Body and .Card Footer partials as props. With `clickable` (the default when `onClick` is set) the whole surface is clickable and shows Pressed on hover and press; with `clickable={false}` it has no hover and only the nested Buttons respond. Stop propagation in nested buttons so they don't also trigger a clickable card (`CardMoreActions` already does).

## Example

From the Storybook story; names like `args` or `label` are the story controls.

```tsx
<StoryCard {...args} />
```

## Figma notes

Mirrors the Figma Card: State (Default / Pressed / Disabled) + Focus, with the .Card Body and .Card Footer partials as props.
- The stroke is Inside in Figma: painted by ::before over the content, so it takes no room.
- Pressed is Background/Hover, an overlay painted by ::after on top of the surface (like the stacked Figma fills). It shows on hover and press, and only when the card is clickable; `data-pressed` forces it.
- Disabled is the whole card at 50% opacity, without the shadow.
- Focus is the 3px Border/Accent/Strong ring, 2px away from the card.

Parts:
- `CardMoreActions`: Figma Show More Actions: the Small icon-only Ghost Button with More Vertical. Clicks don't reach the card; use it as a Dropdown trigger.

## Props

Documented props only; every component also accepts the props of the element or Base UI part it renders (`className`, events, ARIA…).

`CardProps`:

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `disabled?` | `boolean` | Figma State=Disabled. |
| `clickable?` | `boolean` | Makes the whole surface clickable: `onClick` fires on it, it shows Pressed on hover and press, and it's focusable (a plain card gets `role="button"` and responds to Enter and Space). Defaults to true when `onClick` is set. When false, the surface does nothing and has no hover; nested Buttons stay clickable. |
| `label?` | `React.ReactNode` | Figma Label (the title): Label/Medium in Text/Primary. |
| `description?` | `React.ReactNode` | Figma Show Description: Body/Medium in Text/Secondary. |
| `details?` | `React.ReactNode` | Figma Show Details: Body/Small in Text/Secondary. |
| `detailsTrend?` | `ListItemTrend` | Figma Show Icon Trend: the trend icon before the details. |
| `tag?` | `React.ReactNode` | Figma Show Tag: a Small Accent Strong Tag under the text. |
| `icon?` | `IconSvgElement` | Figma Show Icon: a Hugeicons icon in the Icon Colors container. |
| `iconColor?` | `VariantProps<typeof iconColorsVariants>["color"]` | Color of the Icon Colors container (Figma Icon Colors Color). |
| `moreActions?` | `React.ReactNode` | Figma Show More Actions: pass a `<CardMoreActions />`. |
| `children?` | `React.ReactNode` | Figma Body Type=Custom: replaces the whole body content. |
| `footer?` | `React.ReactNode` | Figma Show Footer: one or two Medium Buttons (Primary, Secondary, or Secondary + Primary for Type=Buttons), or one Ghost Button with `footerType="ghost"`. |

## Rules

- Import `Card` from `@s0l/design-system`. Do not rebuild it with plain HTML and Tailwind classes.
- Style it through its props and variants first. Use `className` only for layout (margin, width, grid placement), never to change its colors, typography or radius.
- Colors come from the S0L tokens; see [color](../foundations/color.md).
